get.description: Pages through definitions. Supports q, sort, filter[kind], filter[appKey], filter[published], fields, page and pageSize.

post.summary: Create a definition as a draft
post.description: Creates the envelope and a draft version 1. The kind must be registered; the payload may be incomplete until validation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

get.description: Returns the envelope with its versions and the actions the user may take; the ETag is the envelope revision.

put.description: Changes the title and description of the envelope. Needs If-Match with the envelope ETag.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

get.summary: Get one version with its payload
get.description: Returns any version (draft, published or retired) with its payload.
Returns the open draft (Draft or Validated) with its payload; the ETag is the draft revision.

put.description: Replaces the payload of the open draft and sets it back to Draft status. Needs If-Match with the draft ETag.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

delete.description: Deletes the open draft; the only version of a definition cannot be discarded. Needs If-Match.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

get.description: Returns a hash-checked package of the published version, or of the version given in the query.

post.description: Clones the published version (or the given version) into a new draft. Needs If-Match with the envelope ETag.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

post.description: Checks the draft against its kind (components, options, limits) and records its references; answers 422 with pointers when invalid. Needs If-Match with the draft ETag.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

post.description: Validates and publishes the draft as the current version; the previous version is retired. Needs permission Approve and If-Match with the draft ETag.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

post.summary: Roll back to an older version
post.description: Publishes an older version again as a new version number; history is never rewritten. Needs permission Approve and If-Match with the envelope ETag.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

post.description: Checks every item (kind, payload, content hash) and creates drafts; nothing is published.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

get.description: Pages through the discipline master data. Supports q, sort, filter[isActive], filter[transmittalCode], fields, page and pageSize (offset paging, at most 10,000 rows).

post.description: Creates a discipline and answers 201 with Location and ETag. A repeated Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the first response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; a replay with the same key and body returns the first response.

get.description: Returns one discipline with its ETag and the actions the signed-in user may take.

put.description: Replaces all writable fields. Needs If-Match with the ETag of the last read.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

patch.summary: Change some fields of a discipline
patch.description: JSON Merge Patch (application/merge-patch+json): absent fields stay, null clears a nullable field. Needs If-Match.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

delete.description: Deletes an unused discipline; one that other records use gives 409 (deactivate it with PATCH isActive=false). Needs If-Match.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last read; a missing header gives 428, a stale one 412.

412.description: The resource changed since it was read.

cookieAuth.description: The sign-in cookie issued by /Account/Login; its name is the setting Authentication:Cookie:Name. Unsafe verbs also need the X-CSRF-TOKEN header.
cookieAuth.name: Authentication:Cookie:Name
